name: Blackjack
tagline: Beat the dealer to 21 without going over.
rulesSummary: Everyone plays against the dealer (the house). Place a bet, then you get two cards face up; the dealer gets one up and one down.
Cards count their number, faces 10, aces 1 or 11. Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over.
Hit for another card or stand. Double down on your first two cards: double the bet, take exactly one more card. Split a pair into two hands (up to four; split aces get one card each).
With an ace showing, you may insure for half your bet (pays 2:1 if the dealer has blackjack). The dealer checks for blackjack under an ace or ten.
The dealer draws to 17. A win pays 1:1, blackjack (ace and a ten on the first two cards) pays 3:2, a tie is a push. Most chips after the last round wins.
